{{CharInfobox| color={{water color}} | corecolor={{water color light}} | bordercolor={{water color dark}} | name=Nicholai | jname=キヨ | tmname=Kiyo | slogan=no | image=Nicholai.png | size=230px | caption=Nicholai | gender=Male | colors=yes | eyes=Black | hair=Green | hometown=Unknown | region=[[Hoenn]] | trainer=yes | trainerclass={{pkmn|Trainer}} | game=no | leader=no | team=no | brain=no | anime=yes | epnum=AG005 | epname=In the Knicker of Time! | enva=[[Andrew Rannells]] | java=[[Chie Satō]] | }} '''Nicholai''' (Japanese: '''キヨ''' ''Kiyo'') is a recurring character of {{aniseries|RS}}. He is a [[Pokémon Trainer]] in [[Hoenn]] who is obsessed with {{wp|Knickerbockers (clothing)|knickerbockers}} and {{pkmn|cosplay}}ing as {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. ==History== Nicholai first appeared in ''[[AG005|In the Knicker of Time!]]''. {{Ash}}, {{an|May}}, {{an|Brock}}, and [[Max]] were traveling through the [[Petalburg Woods]] on the way to [[Rustboro City]]. They were surprised to see a gigantic {{p|Zigzagoon}}, but it was actually Nicholai in a costume. He was trying to lure the wild Zigzagoon closer so he could battle them. Ash and his friends scared the Zigzagoon away, and an irritated Nicholai introduced himself to the group. The boy then showed off his collection of Pokémon costumes. Nicholai explained that he believed that his costumes allowed him to know what a Pokémon felt like. In addition, the costumes helped him blend in with wild Pokémon. Nicholai wanted a Zigzagoon so he could challenge [[Norman]] at the [[Petalburg Gym|Petalburg City Gym]]. After learning that May was Norman's daughter, Nicholai excitedly challenged May to a Pokémon battle. Nicholai sent out his {{p|Mudkip}} and May used her only Pokémon, {{TP|May|Torchic}}. Mudkip easily knocked out Torchic with a couple of {{m|Water Gun}} attacks. Nicholai then concluded that since May lost so horribly, Norman must be a pushover in battle too. Max, angry at Nicholai for insulting his father, followed him as he continued his endeavor to capture a Zigzagoon. Max stole Nicholai's Pokémon bait, but ended up being surrounded by a pack of the {{type|Normal}} Pokémon. Ash and the others rescued Max. Eventually, with the help of his Mudkip, Nicholai caught a Zigzagoon. {{TRT}} tried to steal Mudkip, but Nicholai used a {{p|Gligar}} costume to fly up and rescue the Mud Fish Pokémon. {{AP|Pikachu}} then blasted Team Rocket off with an {{type|Electric}} attack. Nicholai used his new Zigzagoon in a battle against [[Ash's Taillow]] before parting for [[Petalburg City]]. His second and final appearance was in ''[[AG048|ZigZag Zangoose!]]''. When Ash and his friends were traveling to [[Fallarbor Town]], they once again met Nicholai on {{rt|111|Hoenn}}. This time, he was dressed up as a {{p|Zangoose}} and he had one of his own. He informed the group that he had challenged [[Norman]], but was defeated. [[Caroline|May and Max's mother]] told him where they were headed, so he came to meet them. He battled Ash, using his newly evolved {{p|Marshtomp}} against {{AP|Treecko}}. Treecko managed to win. Later, when the trio tried to steal Nicholai's Marshtomp, his Zangoose came to the rescue. Nicholai and his Zangoose battled with {{TP|Jessie|Seviper}} and defeated it with a powerful {{m|Crush Claw}}. After Team Rocket was blasted off, Nicholai and Ash had one last battle, though the winner was not revealed. ==Character== Nicholai tends to be overexcited, adventurous, and blunt, to a point where it irritates others. He considers himself a {{wp|Natural history|naturalist}} and has an in-depth knowledge of Pokémon behavior. He uses his Pokémon cosplays to interact with {{pkmn2|wild}} species and become closer with his own Pokémon during {{pkmn|battle}}. In battle, Nicholai's observation skills help him to overcome a difficult opponent. In ''[[AG048|ZigZag Zangoose!]]'', he went on to defeat [[Jessie's Seviper]] after observing [[May's Skitty]] chase {{Ash}} in a {{p|Seviper}} costume. Nicholai uses evasion techniques to keep some distance between his Pokémon and his opponent's, before unleashing powerful attacks to deal the finishing blow. ==Known cosplays== File:Nicholai Tentacruel Cosplay.png|{{p|Tentacruel}} cosplay File:Nicholai Bellossom Cosplay.png|{{p|Bellossom}} cosplay File:Nicholai Aipom Cosplay.png|{{p|Aipom}} cosplay File:Nicholai Gligar Cosplay.png|{{p|Gligar}} cosplay File:Nicholai Mudkip Cosplay.png|{{p|Mudkip}} cosplay File:Nicholai Marshtomp Cosplay.png|{{p|Marshtomp}} cosplay File:Nicholai Zigzagoon Cosplay.png|{{p|Zigzagoon}} cosplay File:Nicholai Zangoose Cosplay.png|{{p|Zangoose}} cosplay ==Pokémon== This listing is of Nicholai's Pokémon in {{aniseries|RS}}. {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Nicholai |pkmn=Marshtomp |stage1=Mudkip |type1=Water |type2=Ground |img=Nicholai Mudkip.png |cap=Nicholai's Mudkip |img2=Nicholai Marshtomp.png |cap2=Nicholai's Marshtomp |epnum=AG005 |epname=In the Knicker of Time! |vajp=Makoto Tsumura |vaen=Lindsey Warner |vaen2=Kayzie Rogers |vaennote=as Mudkip |vaen2note=as Marshtomp |desc=Nicholai's {{p|Marshtomp}} first appeared as a {{p|Mudkip}} in ''[[AG005|In the Knicker of Time!]]''.
